item.title: Ghost Phenomena: Discoveries of the Searcher Group — Sat Oct 3, 2:00 PM — High Park
item.description:
Come to learn about true case discoveries, original theories on life‑after‑life, tools of the trade, and rare field photos while debunking common misconceptions about ghosts and how to properly investigate them. Blending chills, humour, and a deep respect for Ontario’s disappearing heritage, this presentation welcomes skeptics, believers, and the simply curious. Early attendees can enjoy a special pre‑show video at 2:00 pm before the main talk begins at 2:30 pm. Skeptics, believers and the curious alike are invited to attend this judgment-free event and stay for the Q&A at the end. This program is presented by Peter Roe, the Assistant Director of The Searcher Group and Director of its subdivision, Mortal Coil Paranormal. A seasoned investigator, author, and advocate for Ontario’s heritage. Peter is the author of Haunted Town Halls and co‑author of The Complete Paranormal Investigation Handbook. Drop in, no registration required.
Source: Toronto Public Library — Teens

item.title: The Beach and East Toronto Historical Society — Wed Oct 7, 7:00 PM — Beach United Church
item.description:
The Beach and East Toronto Historical Society (TBETHS) has an upcoming event and presentation at the Beach United Church. Architect and Author David Winterton will discuss his recently published book “Toronto Edwardian: Frank Darling, Architect of Canada’s Imperial Age.” The presentation will highlight some of the well known buildings Frank Darling designed in the Beach neighbourhood. Copies of the book will be available for purchase at the event. Admission is free. For more information visit www.tbeths.com
